{
  "phoneNote": "The deliberately typographic dark-and-yellow industrial theme works well, though repeating 'Pokličite' buttons in almost every section feels redundant.",
  "desktopNote": "The hero section has a clean, utilitarian two-column layout, but several lower sections suffer from unbalanced grids and repeated call-to-action buttons.",

  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Remove the repeated 'Pokličite' buttons from the middle sections ('Od klica do pisne ponudbe' and 'Kje delamo') so the hero and final CTA carry the action.",
    "Merge the standalone 'Namesto kotla na olje toplotna črpalka' section into the services list, as it repeats the exact same service already listed under 'Kaj delamo'.",
    "Balance the desktop 'Mojstrski izpit' section by placing the owner's credentials in a right-hand column instead of leaving the right third of the screen empty."
  ]
}
